name: @chewygumxx/skill-worktrunk
description: Operates and configures Worktrunk, the `wt` CLI for Git worktrees. Use when a user mentions Worktrunk, `wt switch`, `wt list`, `wt merge`, `wt remove`, `wt step`, `wt hook`, `wt config`, or `.config/wt.toml`, including worktree targeting, shell integration, hook approvals, ignored-file copying, aliases, and generated commit messages.
